Title: Prayer to St. Joseph
Subtitle: Patron of the Universal Church
IntroText: Pope Leo XIII officially proclaimed St. Joseph Patron of the Universal Church in 1870. He is also patron of fathers, workers, and the dying.

Blocks.Text: O Blessed Saint Joseph, faithful guardian and protector of virgins,
to whom God entrusted Jesus and Mary,
I pray and beseech thee to help me in all my necessities,
to intercede for me with thy foster child Jesus Christ,
and to turn away from me all dangers of soul and body.
I beseech thee, through the love thou didst bear for Jesus and Mary,
not to abandon me in my needs,
but to present my cause before the throne of God.
